messages:
noah: Quick sync: ops flagged that console error tags are leaking internal routing codes. Can we agree a tiny public surface for clients and dashboards?
sienna: We should limit surface to an enum + two short hints. Keeps SDKs simple and dashboards consistent.
marta: Proposal: enums = RETRYABLE, LIMIT, DEGRADED, ACTION_REQUIRED. Keep display text in i18n layer, do not change enum names later.
kevin: Add small machine hints: retry_hint (retryable/no-retry) and can_fallback (true/false). API also returns optional quota_reset_seconds when LIMIT.
noah: Example payload to include in RFC: {"error_category":"LIMIT","display":"Limit reached","retry_hint":"no-retry","can_fallback":"false","quota_reset_seconds":"1200"} — literal in the RFC contract.
sienna: Routing semantics: RETRYABLE -> automatic retries allowed; DEGRADED -> best-effort responses with reduced features; LIMIT -> do not fallback automatically; ACTION_REQUIRED -> surface clear CTA.
marta: Telemetry: emit new tag error_category and keep legacy_code during a 30d migration window. Dashboards should support both until migration complete.
kevin: Headers for observability: X-Error-Category, X-Fallback-Used, X-Quota-Reset. Clients can log these for support.
noah: Console UX: short badge text (from i18n) + icon. Tooltip shows a one-sentence hint and the retry policy. Keep tooltip <100 chars.
sienna: Color palette: RETRYABLE=amber, DEGRADED=orange, LIMIT=blue, ACTION_REQUIRED=red. Blue for LIMIT to avoid alarm.
marta: Rollout: feature-flag the contract (client_error_v2), enable in canary, emit both metric tags for 30 days, then flip console. Add a migration table mapping old codes to new enums.
ops-bot: deploy-notice: client_error_v2 canary scheduled 2025-02-07T04:00Z.
kevin: SDK guidance: if retry_hint=="retryable" use exponential backoff; if "no-retry" surface CTA to upgrade/support. Include small unit tests asserting headers are present on fallback.
noah: I'll draft the RFC with enum definitions, sample payloads, header mapping, metric migration table, and rollout checklist. Tagging SDK, dashboard, and docs owners. Any objections to the 4-bucket model?
sienna: No objections. Please keep enum names stable even if display strings change.
